**Finding submitted: deviation (LOL-CAP), targeted at the preferred position.**

Section 21 is otherwise strong — mutual cap, mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages, and a full "Excluded Claims" set (confidentiality, data protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement). The defect is the cap **basis**: "Fees" is defined at 1.5/1.6 as only the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee stated in the first Order Form, and 21.1 further restricts the measure to that first Order Form. Both Parties' aggregate liability is therefore effectively USD 12,000 — well inside walk-away territory (below 6 months' fees), and the 21.3 payment carve-out inherits the same narrow noun so Customer's real payment obligations are not excluded from capped damages.

Two surgical edits (validated, minimality gate passed):
1. **p0089** — cap becomes the greater of lowercase *fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms* in the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim, and USD 1,000,000 (existing temporal anchor preserved verbatim; mutuality sentence untouched).
2. **p0091** — payment carve-out changed from "undisputed Fees" to "undisputed amounts due", so all Customer payment obligations sit outside the cap.

All remaining preferred elements were mapped as already met against verbatim text, with no duplicative new language added.
